newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * The upper house, the Senate, met in its last session after general elections to assess four years of activity.
* Oliviu Gherman, Senate Chairman, said the house passed 599 bills, of which 537 were promulgated by the president. Also 174 governmental decisions were adopted.
* The new Senate meets on Friday, November 22, to form up the commission to validate new MPs' mandates.

* Adrian Nastase, Executive President of the leftist Party of Social Democracy said his party would leave parliament if outgoing President Ion Iliescu's mandate as Senator was invalidated as has been suggested by some members.
He said Iliescu would rejoin the PDSR as soon as he is allowed under the terms of the constitution.
* Outgoing Foreign Minister Teodor Melescanu held his last news conference. He said that during his mandate Romania boosted its efforts to join the European Union and NATO.
Melescanu also signalled a normalisation of ties with neighbouring countries, stressing the political treaty signed with Hungary in September.
Melescanu said Romania's new leadership must keep as its main goal Euro-Atlantic integration. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
